messages.content: 你能幫我理解非洲大象在塞倫蓋提生態系中過去5年的生態影響，並評估同一物種在同一地點過去10年的族群增長嗎？之後，我也想知道孟加拉虎在巽德班生態系中過去3年的生態影響，並評估同一物種在同一地點過去7年的族群增長。

function.name: wildlife_population_assess_growth
function.description: Assesses the population growth of a specific species in a specified location over a period. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The area where the species is present.

function.description: Analyzes the impact of a species on a particular ecosystem. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The area where the impact is analyzed.

timeframe.description: The time period for which the impact analysis should be carried out in years.

The user wants two analyses:

1. For African elephant (species) in Serengeti ecosystem at location "Serengeti" (?) They want ecological impact over past 5 years and population growth over past 10 years.

2. For Bengal tiger in Sundarbans ecosystem at location "Sundarbans" (?) They want ecological impact over past 3 years and population growth over past 7 years.

We need to call the appropriate functions. We have two functions: wildlife_population_assess_growth(species, location, duration) and ecological_impact_analyze(species, ecosystem, location, timeframe?). The user didn't specify ecosystem names explicitly but we can infer from context: Serengeti ecosystem for African elephant; Sundarbans ecosystem for Bengal tiger. So we will call ecological_impact_analyze twice with species and ecosystem and location same as species? Actually the function signature: ecological_impact_analyze takes species, ecosystem, location, timeframe optional default 5. So we need to pass species, ecosystem, location, timeframe. For first request: species="African elephant", ecosystem="Serengeti ecosystem", location="Serengeti", timeframe=5. For second: species="Bengal tiger", ecosystem="Sundarbans ecosystem", location="Sundarbans", timeframe=3.

Then we also need to call wildlife_population_assess_growth twice: first with species="African elephant", location="Serengeti", duration=10. Second with species="Bengal tiger", location="Sundarbans", duration=7.
